hook: College mein ho? Google ka AI Plus plan ek saal free mil raha hai. Par sirf thirty one December tak.

beats.narration: College mein ho? Google ka AI Plus plan ek saal free mil raha hai. Par sirf thirty one December tak.
Google ka page saaf likhta hai: redeem until thirty one December twenty twenty six.
beats.claim: Google's India student page: 'Redeem until 31 December 2026'.

beats.narration: Kya milega? Double usage limit, chaar sau GB storage, aur Study Notebooks aur Live mein unlimited uploads.
beats.claim: Includes 2x usage limits, 400 GB storage, Gemini Omni, unlimited uploads for Study Notebooks, Visuals and Live.

beats.narration: Shart: aap eighteen plus hone chahiye aur college ya university mein padh rahe ho. Verification SheerID se hoti hai, college email ya fee receipt se.
beats.claim: Eligible university students aged 18+, verified via SheerID with college email or a document.

beats.narration: Apna personal Gmail use karo, college wala account nahi chalega. Aur payment method add karna padega.
beats.claim: Use a personal Gmail with a payment method; college-issued accounts aren't eligible.

beats.narration: Dhyaan rahe: saal khatam hote hi teen sau ninyaanve rupaye mahina lagega, jab tak cancel na karo. Calendar mein reminder laga lo.
beats.claim: After the trial, ₹399/month is charged automatically unless you cancel.

beats.narration: Apne college group mein bhejo. Kisi ka saal bach jaayega.

title: College students: Google AI Plus 1 saal free, 31 Dec tak
description: Google AI Plus student plan: 1 saal free, 18+ college students, redeem by 31 Dec 2026. Uske baad ₹399/month jab tak cancel na karo. Source: gemini.google/in/students.
